checks.name: Exactly one receipt per call and one missed-call notice
320px: call buttons, composer and Send on screen; keyboard-height viewport keeps the composer

limitations: Camera switching (front/back) needs a device with two cameras; the synthetic Chromium camera is single, so Flip Camera is correctly hidden and only camera on/off was exercised.

Mobile Safari: verified only as Playwright WebKit with iPhone 13 emulation on Linux, receive-only (no synthetic camera or microphone in WebKit). Safari on a physical iPhone was not available to this run.
The on-screen keyboard is emulated by shrinking the viewport to 300px; a real iOS/Android keyboard was not opened.

Real push notifications to a phone were not delivered: throwaway accounts have no push subscription (by design, so no real phone rings). The server push enqueue was read back and the Accept destination route was exercised instead.
